Royal salon, at the bottom of which large stairway, adorned, and supported by columns. From the two parts of the stairway down two great gates. The King, Geneva and Ariodante, taken by the hand, Dalinda and Lurcanio equally taken by the hand, and Odoardo, Knights and Dame to the King's follow, all descend with solemnity for the great stairway. At the same time, enter by the two gates Guards and People. As the King descends the choir, and the Dames and Knights form the dance.
